method.entrySnapshot: Closed candles only, cutoff at confirmation close; rolling 5000 bars M5/M15/M30 and 1500 H1/H4/D. Historical M1 unavailable for all entries, so no M1 claims.
method.analysis: Same market structure engine, mapped confirmation timing, VIP support, H4 Swing Fib, current-day Nepal Fib and post-CHoCH H1 Fib functions as the dashboard/server. Only active valid zones count as obstacles; pending zones are listed separately. All price obstacles are measured against actual first-leg entry and fixed TP.
method.limitations: Reconstruction depends on available OHLC and rolling history. Zones are as known at entry, not hindsight-created zones. Reaction checks exclude both fill and exit candles and cannot prove causation. Plain, Fib-aligned and engulfing-confirmed zones are distinct. M5 context has shorter warmup than M15. Spread, slippage, historical news and account-specific execution constraints are not resolved by OHLC.
method.scope: Research only; trading code and settings unchanged.
